title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: A quick American-style breakfast made with blended oats and ripe banana.

instructions.text: Blend the oats until finely ground, then add the banana, eggs, milk, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Blend to a smooth batter and let it stand for 5 minutes while a skillet heats over medium heat.
Brush the skillet with oil and cook small rounds until bubbles form, then turn and cook until set.

title: Blueberry Banana Oat Pancakes
description: The banana-oat pancakes with blueberries folded into each batch.

instructions.text: Blend the oats until finely ground, then blend in the banana, eggs, milk, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes, then fold in the blueberries without crushing them.
Brush a medium-hot skillet with oil and cook small rounds on both sides until set.

title: Apple Cinnamon Overnight Oats
description: A chilled make-ahead breakfast with apple, yogurt, and warm spice.

instructions.text: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup, and cinnamon together until evenly combined.
Fold in half of the diced apple, cover, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
Stir before serving and top with the remaining apple.

title: Oat-Milk Apple Overnight Oats
description: The apple overnight oats with oat milk in place of dairy milk.

instructions.text: Stir the oats, oat milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup, and cinnamon together.
Fold in half of the apple, cover, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
Stir well and spoon the remaining apple over the chilled oats.

title: Spinach Tomato Egg Skillet
description: A savory skillet breakfast with tender greens and tomatoes.

instructions.text: Heat the oil in a covered skillet and soften the onion with the paprika and salt.
Add the tomatoes and spinach and cook until the tomatoes soften and the spinach wilts.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook until the whites and yolks are fully set.

title: Lemon Chickpea Toast
description: A bright Mediterranean-inspired chickpea spread on crisp whole-wheat toast.

instructions.text: Mash the garbanzo beans with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil, leaving some texture.
Toast the bread until crisp at the edges.
Fold the parsley into the chickpea mixture and spoon it over the warm toast.

title: Peanut Butter Apple Oat Bites
description: A no-bake oat snack with crisp apple and peanut butter.

instructions.text: Mix the oats, peanut butter, maple syrup, chia seeds, and cinnamon into a thick dough.
Fold in the diced apple and chill the mixture for 20 minutes.
Roll into twelve bite-size balls and keep chilled until serving.

title: Red Lentil Coconut Stew
description: A pantry-friendly, South Asian-inspired stew with ginger and gentle curry spices.

instructions.text: Cook the onion in a splash of the coconut milk until soft, then stir in the garlic, ginger, and curry powder.
Add the lentils, remaining coconut milk, tomatoes, and broth and simmer gently until the lentils are tender.
Fold in the spinach and cook just until wilted before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Red Lentil Stew
description: A thicker child variant with sweet potato and slightly milder seasoning.

ingredients.name: Sweet potato
ingredients.preparation_notes: peeled and cut into small cubes

instructions.text: Soften the onion in a splash of coconut milk, then stir in the garlic, ginger, and curry powder.
Add the lentils, sweet potato, remaining coconut milk, tomatoes, and broth and simmer until both the lentils and potato are tender.
Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted, adding a little water only if the stew is too thick.

title: Tomato White Bean Soup
description: A rustic Mediterranean-inspired soup with beans, vegetables, and basil.

instructions.text: Heat the oil in a soup pot and cook the onion, carrot, and celery until softened.
Stir in the garlic, tomatoes, beans, and broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
Fold in the basil and lightly mash a few beans to give the broth more body.

title: Black Bean Sweet Potato Chili
description: A Mexican-inspired meatless chili with smoky spice and tender sweet potato.

instructions.text: Heat the oil in a heavy pot and soften the onion and bell pepper.
Stir in the cumin and smoked paprika, then add the sweet potato, tomatoes, beans, and broth.
Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the sweet potato is tender and the chili has thickened.

title: Chicken Ginger Rice Soup
description: An East Asian-inspired chicken soup with ginger, rice, and scallions.

instructions.text: Bring the broth, ginger, carrot, celery, and rice to a gentle simmer.
Add the chicken and simmer until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C) on a food thermometer.
Transfer the chicken to a clean board, shred it, and return it to the soup with the soy sauce.
Cook until the rice is tender, then scatter the green onion over each serving.

title: Mushroom Barley Soup
description: A hearty vegetable soup with earthy mushrooms and chewy pearl barley.

instructions.text: Heat the oil in a soup pot and cook the mushrooms until their moisture evaporates and the edges brown.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic and thyme.
Add the barley and broth and simmer until the barley is tender and the soup is lightly thickened.

title: Lemon Herb Chickpea Quinoa Bowl
description: A fresh Mediterranean-inspired grain bowl with chickpeas and tahini dressing.

instructions.text: Cook the quinoa according to its package directions, then spread it out to cool slightly.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, and tahini with a splash of water until pourable.
Divide the quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, and tomatoes among bowls and finish with parsley and dressing.

title: Brown Rice Chickpea Bowl
description: The lemon-herb bowl made with cooked brown rice instead of quinoa.

instructions.text: Cook the brown rice ahead of time and allow it to cool until just warm.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, and tahini with enough water to make a pourable dressing.
Divide the brown rice, chickpeas, cucumber, and tomatoes among bowls and top with parsley and dressing.

title: Sesame Tofu Broccoli Rice Bowl
description: An East Asian-inspired rice bowl with crisp-edged tofu and a savory sesame sauce.

instructions.text: Cook the rice according to its package directions and keep it covered off the heat.
Brown the tofu in a wide skillet, then add the broccoli and carrot with a splash of water and cover until crisp-tender.
Stir together the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and garlic and toss the mixture through the skillet.
Spoon the tofu and vegetables over rice and scatter with sesame seeds.

title: Sesame Tempeh Broccoli Rice Bowl
description: The sesame rice bowl with nutty browned tempeh in place of tofu.

instructions.text: Cook the rice according to its package directions and keep it covered off the heat.
Brown the tempeh strips on both sides in a wide skillet.
Add the broccoli and carrot with a splash of water and cover until crisp-tender.
Toss with the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and garlic, then serve over rice with sesame seeds.

title: Roasted Vegetable Couscous Salad
description: A colorful North African-inspired couscous salad with roasted vegetables and chickpeas.

instructions.text: Toss the courgette, bell pepper, and red onion with half the olive oil and roast until browned at the edges.
Prepare the couscous according to its package directions, fluff it, and let it cool slightly.
Fold together the couscous, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, lemon juice, remaining oil, and parsley.

title: Tuna White Bean Salad
description: A no-cook Mediterranean-inspired salad with tuna, beans, and crisp vegetables.

instructions.text: Whisk the lemon juice and olive oil in a large bowl.
Add the beans, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and parsley and toss to coat.
Flake the tuna over the salad and fold gently so some larger pieces remain.

title: Lentil Beet Walnut Salad
description: An earthy lentil salad balanced with roasted beets, feta, and walnuts.

instructions.text: Toss the beets with a little of the olive oil and roast until tender and browned at the edges.
Simmer the lentils in water until tender but intact, then drain and cool slightly.
Whisk the remaining oil with the vinegar and toss with the lentils, beets, and rocket; top with feta and walnuts.

title: Tomato Basil Spaghetti
description: A simple Italian-inspired pasta with a garlic tomato sauce and fresh basil.

instructions.text: Soften the onion in olive oil, stir in the garlic and tomato paste, then add the crushed tomato and simmer until thickened.
Cook the spaghetti in boiling water until just tender, reserving a little cooking water before draining.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce and enough reserved water to coat, then fold in the basil and top with Parmesan.

title: Whole-Wheat Spinach Tomato Spaghetti
description: The tomato basil pasta with whole-wheat spaghetti and spinach.

instructions.text: Soften the onion in olive oil, stir in the garlic and tomato paste, then add the crushed tomato and simmer until thickened.
Cook the wholemeal spaghetti according to its package directions, reserving a little cooking water before draining.
Stir the spinach into the sauce until wilted.
Toss in the pasta with enough reserved water to coat, then add the basil and Parmesan.

title: Mushroom Whole-Wheat Tomato Spaghetti
description: A third-generation tomato pasta variant with browned mushrooms and spinach.

instructions.text: Brown the mushrooms in half the olive oil and transfer them to a plate.
Use the remaining oil to soften the onion, then add the garlic, tomato paste, and crushed tomato and simmer until thickened.
Cook the wholemeal spaghetti according to its package directions and reserve a little cooking water.
Wilt the spinach into the sauce, return the mushrooms, and toss with the pasta, basil, Parmesan, and enough cooking water to coat.

title: Mushroom Pea Risotto
description: A creamy Italian-inspired rice dish with mushrooms, peas, and Parmesan.

instructions.text: Melt half the butter in a wide pan and brown the mushrooms, then transfer them to a plate.
Melt the remaining butter, soften the onion, stir in the garlic, and toast the rice for 1 minute.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting for each addition to absorb before adding more.
When the rice is tender and loose, fold in the peas, mushrooms, and Parmesan and serve immediately.

title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Chicken and Vegetables
description: A practical sheet-pan dinner with lemon, oregano, potatoes, and broccoli.

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F), toss the potatoes with one-third of the oil, and roast for 15 minutes.
Mix the remaining oil with the lemon juice, garlic, and oregano and coat the chicken and broccoli.
Add the chicken and broccoli to the pan and roast until the potatoes are tender and the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) on a food thermometer.

title: Baked Dill Salmon with Potatoes
description: A bright salmon dinner with dill, green beans, and roasted potatoes.

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.preparation_notes: halved if small or cut into 3 cm pieces

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (425°F), toss the potatoes with half the oil, and roast for 20 minutes.
Mix the remaining oil with the lemon juice, dill, and garlic and brush it over the salmon and green beans.
Add the salmon and beans to the pan and bake until the salmon reaches 145°F (63°C) on a food thermometer and the vegetables are tender.

title: Turkey Meatballs with Tomato Spaghetti
description: An Italian American-style pasta dinner with tender turkey meatballs and tomato sauce.

instructions.text: Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, half the Parmesan, and half the garlic and shape into small meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in the oil, then transfer them to a clean plate and soften the onion in the same pan.
Add the remaining garlic and crushed tomato, return the meatballs, and simmer until their centers reach 165°F (74°C) on a food thermometer.
Cook and drain the spaghetti, toss it with the sauce, and serve with the meatballs and remaining Parmesan.

title: Black Bean Tacos
description: A Mexican-inspired taco filling with sautéed peppers, beans, and crunchy cabbage.

instructions.text: Toss the cabbage with half the lime juice and half the fresh coriander.
Heat the oil in a skillet, soften the onion and bell pepper, then add the beans and warm them through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet until flexible.
Fill each tortilla with the bean mixture, cabbage, avocado, remaining lime juice, and fresh coriander.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: An East Asian-inspired fried rice designed for cooked, chilled rice.

instructions.text: Heat a little neutral oil in a wide skillet, scramble the eggs until just set, and transfer them to a plate.
Add the remaining neutral oil and cook the carrot and peas until crisp-tender.
Add the chilled rice and cook, tossing, until hot and separated.
Return the eggs and stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, and scallion.

title: Herbed Chickpea Patties with Tahini
description: A Middle Eastern-inspired baked chickpea patty with parsley and lemon tahini.

instructions.text: Mash the chickpeas until mostly broken down, then mix in the onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour, and half the olive oil.
Shape into eight patties, brush with the remaining oil, and arrange on a lined baking sheet.
Bake at 220°C (425°F), turning once, until firm and browned on both sides.
Whisk the tahini and lemon juice with enough water to make a spoonable sauce and serve with the patties.

title: Carrot Walnut Snack Cake
description: A simple spiced carrot cake with walnuts and an unfrosted finish.

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F), grease a 20 cm square pan, and line its base.
Whisk the flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and bicarbonate of soda together.
Whisk the sugar, eggs, and oil, fold in the dry ingredients, then fold in the carrots and nuts.
Spread the batter in the pan and bake until the center springs back and a tester comes out clean; cool before slicing.

title: Lower-Sugar Pecan Carrot Cake
description: The carrot snack cake with less sugar and pecans replacing the walnuts.

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F), grease a 20 cm square pan, and line its base.
Whisk the flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and bicarbonate of soda together.
Whisk the sugar, eggs, and oil, fold in the dry ingredients, then fold in the carrots and nuts.
Spread the batter in the pan and bake until the center springs back and a tester comes out clean; cool before slicing.

title: Orange Raisin Carrot Cake
description: A sibling carrot-cake variant with orange zest and raisins instead of walnuts.

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F), grease a 20 cm square pan, and line its base.
Whisk the flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and bicarbonate of soda together.
Whisk the sugar, eggs, oil, and orange zest, fold in the dry ingredients, then fold in the carrots and raisins.
Spread the batter in the pan and bake until the center springs back and a tester comes out clean; cool before slicing.

title: Blueberry Oat Muffins
description: A lightly spiced breakfast muffin with blueberries and an oat-studded crumb.

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line eight wells of a muffin pan.
Whisk the plain flour, oats, sugar, baking powder, and cinnamon; whisk the egg, milk, and oil separately.
Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients just until combined, then gently fold in the blueberries.
Divide among the prepared wells and bake until risen and a tester comes out clean; cool on a rack.
